note: The design's analysis.model with the family of primary_outcome.type: lm/lmer (continuous), glm/glmer binomial (binary), negative binomial (count), cumulative logit clm/clmm (ordinal), Cox model (survival, needs an event column).

assays: rnaseq, eqtl (expression), single_cell (pseudobulk), small_rnaseq, microbiome, 3' tag-seq
note: Counts per feature (genes, miRNAs, taxa): log2-CPM, per-feature linear model with the design's fixed terms, empirical-Bayes moderated t (as limma-trend).
Long table of IP reads per peak and library; libraries mapped to units; input libraries left out; then as feature_counts.
Reads counted in fixed windows (bin_bp), no peak calling; then as feature_counts. Truth peaks are matched to windows by overlap.
Methylated and total reads per cytosine pooled in windows (per context); M-value per window and unit; moderated t. Truth DMRs matched by overlap.
Array beta values as M-values; moderated t per probe.
IP and input counts per window: log2(IP/input) with IP scaled by its median ratio to input, so expression changes cancel; moderated t.

Line means (BLUEs) of the primary outcome per level of the genotype term from the design's analysis.model, then a kinship mixed-model GWAS on the VCF (rrBLUP or native EMMAX). Truth: QTN found by exact marker or LD (ld_r2), tpr, fdr, sign and estimate agreement.
Cell-level analysis (clusters, cell-type proportions); the pseudobulk is analysed as feature_counts today.
Correlation between traits: cor.test per pair (pearson / spearman / kendall), Holm; raw and within the design (residuals of the design's fixed part). From analysis.correlation.

assays: (raters or methods scoring the same units)
note: Agreement: Cohen's kappa (2 raters), weighted kappa (ordinal), Fleiss' kappa (3+, irr), ICC (continuous, psych). From analysis.agreement.
